## Projects Department Health & Safety Standards

Ref:EGY/PRJCTS/HSE/REQs

- Contractors shall ensure that each and every subcontractor employed on the worksite appoints suitably qualified health and safety staff to ensure the effective function of the health and safety disciplinewithin the subcontractor's organization.

## 2.4.3.1.3. Plant Operators and Drivers:

- Plant operators and drivers are to be in possession of a valid driving license and competence certificate issued by a third party organization for the category of plant or vehicles being operated.

## 2.4.3.1.4. Operatives/Workers:

- All operatives are to be competent for the role they are tofulfil. Specific qualificationswill be required for certain trades and job disciplines such as electricians,welders, scaffolders,users of machinery and power tools, working in confines spaces, first aiders etc. Where there is any doubt of requiredcompetenciesguidanceistobesoughtfromEMAARMisr.
- Evidence of competency is to be provided by certificate of competence held in personnel files, by
- work, if thcy do not hold the necessary competencies to carry out the job.

## 2.4.3.2. Training:

## 2.4.3.2.1. Site Induction and Training:

- LA Training is fundamental in ensuring that each employee receives instructions regarding work hazards and the corresponding controls to mitigate the hazards.
- Contractors are to develop a Training Matrix based on a Training Needs Analysis of their workforce. The matrix is to detail positions such as managers, supervisors, workers etc. and what courses are required by each position and be submitted toEMAARMisrfor review.
- All training is to be conducted in the native language of the worker or be suitably translated.
- In order to confirm the effectiveness of any training, proof of learning is to be conducted (practical or theory) after each course. To ensure training is effective it is to be validated by monitoring and undertaking assessments on site. As necessary, training content and methods of delivery are to be modified to ensure it is effective and adds value.
- Emaar Misr has the right to request the training records at any time in order to verify the effectiveness of the health and safety inductions and the overall trainingprogram.

## 2.4.3.2.2. Induction:

- The Contractor shall provide all personnel working under their control with an induction briefing whichis specific toTheWorks and the sitelocation.The Contractor shall maintain records on site to show that this has taken place.The records shall include:
- Name.
- ·Employeenumber (either related to the security reference that maybe given or a unique reference to the Contractor).
